risks.risk: Book condition may be worse than it looks (missing pages, heavy stains, torn covers, water damage). Photos don’t show page quality or spine condition.
risks.proof: Request clear photos of: (1) the spine, (2) the inside first 5 pages, (3) the last 5 pages, and (4) a close-up of any damage/marks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used books with unknown condition (worst case: not pristine).

risks.risk: Edition/printing may differ (could affect demand and resale value). Photos show titles/authors but not edition/ISBN.
risks.proof: Request a photo of the copyright/ISBN page for both books.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used copies without confirming edition.

risks.risk: Could be missing companion items (e.g., workbook/bonus materials) if any exist for a specific edition.
risks.proof: Request a photo showing the full contents (front/back covers and any included inserts).
risks.if_unproven: Price as only the two books (no extras).

proof_requests: Clear close-ups of spines and edges (top/bottom) for both books
Inside photos: first 5 pages and last 5 pages for both books
Any included inserts/extra materials (if present) photographed
response.reason: The titles/authors are readable and the set of two books is confirmed, but the photos don’t provide enough evidence of actual condition/edition details that materially affect the price in Abuja.
